channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: ‘Decolonizing Medicine’ class at UMD prompts concerns about politicizing health care
item.description: The University of Maryland's new "Decolonizing Medicine" course, which integrates identity politics into medical education, has prompted criticism from physicians.

item.title: ASU New College wants to end recorded staff meetings
item.description: A conservative professor argues that professors fear having to defend their views to the public.

item.title: MBA job market sluggish, ‘struggling to get hired’: report
item.description: 'Even MBAs from top business schools are struggling to get hired.'

item.title: Charlie Kirk’s alleged killer wants entire prosecutor team dismissed
item.description: The trial of Charlie Kirk's alleged killer Tyler Robinson continued to move along. Robinson's attorneys accused the prosecutor's office of being biased due to an official's daughter being present when Kirk was killed.

item.title: Florida, Texas sever ties with ABA law school accreditor amid DEI concerns
item.description: Florida and Texas have removed the American Bar Association's exclusive accreditation role for law schools, citing concerns about DEI and discrimination.

item.title: UCLA professor suspended after quoting MLK plans to appeal loss in court
item.description: 'Professor Klein proved his case at trial with overwhelming evidence. It wasn't even close.'

item.title: Facing criticism, Harvard health center will focus on pediatrics, not Israel
item.description: A Harvard University think tank will shift its focus following extensive criticism that it focused too much on anti-Israel programming.

item.title: DEI staffer plans to sue UCLA after being fired for celebrating Charlie Kirk murder
item.description: Johnathan Perkins, a former UCLA DEI director, plans to sue the university for firing him over social media posts celebrating Charlie Kirk's assassination.

item.title: Up to 25 percent of U.S. colleges may close soon, Brandeis president warns
item.description: Higher education is approaching a period of profound disruption, and many colleges may not survive, Arthur Levine, the newly appointed president of Brandeis University, said during a recent event. item.title: Judge rules against Ohio State U. for expelling student over anti-Israel TikToks
item.description: A federal judge ruled against Ohio State University this month after the school expelled a student for posting anti-Israel videos on social media that administrators claimed encouraged violence.
